name: Coherence Principle
fact: Learners perform better when extraneous information is excluded from multimedia lessons to minimize demands on cognitive resources.
boundary: In authentic learning settings, high learner interest may mitigate the negative effects of extraneous information.

provenance.title: Principles for Reducing Extraneous Processing in Multimedia Learning
provenance.quote_or_locus: The coherence principle is that people learn better when extraneous information is excluded from multimedia lessons

provenance.title: Coherence or interest: Which is most important in online multimedia learning?
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results showed students in both treatment groups achieved similar performance. This suggests that in authentic learning settings, interest may mitigate the effects of the coherence principle
